verdict.rationale: Slack documents Slackbot as a built-in 'personal AI agent' that can be asked to prepare briefings, analyze reports, draft project briefs, answer open-ended questions, and update CRM deals, plus AI-generated summaries/recaps and meeting notes — all delivered natively inside Slack without external tools (slack-docs-13,14,15,17,38,55,57). This is first-party marketing/docs evidence with no independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation actually working end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of Slackbot task delegation, and clearer documentation of the range/reliability of delegable tasks beyond summarization and briefings.
